description: This file contains implementation of a dynamic string vector (array) in C, providing functions for initialization, insertion, deletion, splicing, splitting, and other manipulations of string arrays.

methods.name: void strvec_init(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure to an empty state.

methods.name: void strvec_push_nodup(struct strvec * array,char * value)
methods.description: Pushes a string into the vector without duplication, handling the empty state.

methods.name: const char * strvec_push(struct strvec * array,const char * value)
methods.description: Pushes a duplicate of a string into the vector, returning the newly added element.

methods.name: const char * strvec_pushf(struct strvec * array,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Pushes a formatted string into the vector, using variadic arguments.

methods.name: void strvec_pushl(struct strvec * array,...)
methods.description: Pushes multiple strings into the vector from variadic arguments.

methods.name: void strvec_pushv(struct strvec * array,const char ** items)
methods.description: Pushes multiple strings from an array of pointers into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_splice(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,size_t len,const char ** replacement,size_t replacement_len)
methods.description: Replaces a range of elements with new ones, handling memory and boundary checks.

methods.name: const char * strvec_replace(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,const char * replacement)
methods.description: Replaces an element at a specific index with a new string, freeing the old.

methods.name: void strvec_remove(struct strvec * array,size_t idx)
methods.description: Removes an element at a specific index, freeing its memory.

methods.name: void strvec_pop(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Removes and frees the last element of the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_split(struct strvec * array,const char * to_split)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on whitespace and pushes them into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_clear(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector, freeing memory, and reinitializes.

methods.name: const char ** strvec_detach(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Detaches the internal array from the vector, returning it for external use.

ctags.name: strvec_replace
ctags.pattern: /^const char *strvec_replace(struct strvec *array, size_t idx, const char *replacement)$/

ctags.name: strvec_splice
ctags.pattern: /^void strvec_splice(struct strvec *array, size_t idx, size_t len,$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * array,size_t idx,size_t len,const char ** replacement,size_t replacement_len)
